ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: List all interactions in the system

endpoints.name: SearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple interaction fields (subject, description, etc.). Use the 'searchText' parameter for keyword searches.

searchText.description: Text to search across interaction subject, description, and other basic fields

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for simple keyword searches across interaction content. NOT for relationship-based searches.

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including relationships with partners, contacts, dates, and complex filters. Use the `searchCriteria` parameter to specify complex filters. This parameter expects a JSON array of objects, where each object has `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. For example: `[{"field":"partner.name","operator":"like","value":"UNICEF"},{"field":"date","operator":"between","value":"2024-01-01,2024-12-31"}]`. Available fields for search include: `id`, `contactId`, `type`, `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `description`, `subject`, `contactName`, `contactFirstName`, `contactLastName`, `contactEmail`, `partnerName`, `partnerStatus`. Nested fields are also available, such as `contact.firstName`, `contact.lastName`, `partner.name`, `partner.status`. Available operators are: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Date fields are: `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`.

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Show meetings with John Smith contact
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner relationships, contact details, dates, interaction types, or multiple field combinations.
